items.description: Button paddingY matches shadcn (8px vertical padding). Currently 0px in shadcss.
steps: Read packages/shadcss/src/components/button.css
Identify the padding declaration on the .button selector
Add or adjust vertical padding to 8px (0.5rem) to match shadcn canon
Run npm run build to rebuild dist
Run bash scripts/check.sh to verify all gates pass
items.regression_notes: Ensure button height/line-height doesn't break existing showcase layout in apps/www/index.html. Check that button variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) all inherit the padding correctly.

items.description: Progress background uses primary color directly instead of mix:primary. shadcn uses primary for the track background.
steps: Read packages/shadcss/src/components/progress.css
Identify the background declaration on the .progress selector
Change from mix:primary to primary to match shadcn canon
Run npm run build to rebuild dist
Run bash scripts/check.sh to verify all gates pass
items.regression_notes: Ensure the progress bar still renders correctly in both light and dark modes. Check that the progress-indicator (inner bar) contrast against the track remains sufficient. Verify showcase progress examples still look right.
